name: Slime Master
summary:
✨ Welcome to the Quest Shop! Well… actually, there are no quests here.
No coins. No gems. No daily logins.
Your only "quest" is—keep merging!

Legend says a mythical player once created the Golden Crown Slime...
Right after opening this very shop, they merged non-stop for three hours.
So what are you waiting for?

Your true quest is to summon the ultimate Slime!

Who is the true Slime Master?
Who will summon the Golden Crown Slime and rule the leaderboard?
Don’t blink—one merge could change everything!
Merg
